18_zone_radar.title: 20-Zone Spatial Analytics (JDP 4×5 Matrix)
18_zone_radar.description: Juego de Posición tactical grid expanding classic 18-zone model into a 4×5 matrix (4 pitch depths × 5 vertical corridors, highlighting Zone 14 & Half-spaces)

notes.note: Active implementation and test suite authoring for 18-zone radar
Full Vitest unit test suite (5 test cases) covering 20-zone (JDP 4×5) matrix, Zone 14 badges, half-space occupancy, KPI cards, and timestamp seeking verified passing
Testing and benchmarking vertical crop pan & scan logic

9 automated unittests covering edge clamping, missing target interpolation, and jitter damping verified passing. Algorithm-only benchmark: 3000-frame trajectory smoothing in 3ms (pure memory calculation, excluding video decoding and YOLO/SAM tracking I/O)

jersey_tracklet_voting.title: Jersey Number Temporal Tracklet Voting Engine
jersey_tracklet_voting.description: Candidate robust player identification using upper-torso spatial cropping and Dirichlet temporal confidence histogram voting over tracklet windows to resolve motion blur & occlusion

notes.note: Authoring jersey_voting.py prototype and automated unit tests

7 automated unittests covering torso cropping, digit sanitization, and temporal Dirichlet voting verified passing. Algorithm-only benchmark: 22 players over 500 frames in 1ms (pure in-memory voting logic, excluding single-frame vision OCR)

pitch_control_voronoi.title: Lightweight Spearman Pitch Control & Voronoi Territory Estimator
pitch_control_voronoi.description: Physics-based spatial dominance & time-to-intercept model computing territorial dominance and passing lane openness from 2D player coordinates

notes.note: Authoring pitch_control.py prototype with Spearman time-to-intercept model

8 automated unittests covering Spearman time-to-intercept, pitch control logistic probability, 2D territory grid, and passing lane openness verified passing. Algorithm-only benchmark: 21×14 spatial grid with 22 players evaluated in 3ms (pure kinematic vector calculation)
